bandReport.notes:
PDF page 0 (p00.png) IS the instructions cover — 'DO NOT OPEN THIS TEST BOOKLET...', T.B.C. ANFB-S-GKL, Test Booklet Series A, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, Two Hours / 100 marks, footer '( 48 - A )'. Instruction 4 confirms 120 items, each printed in both Hindi and English. NOT transcribed. The PDF appears to hold only the ENGLISH half of the booklet (footers run 3-A, 5-A, 7-A, 9-A, 11-A, 13-A — odd printed pages only), which is why 21 content pages carry 120 questions. Faint Hindi show-through from the reverse leaf is visible on every page but is never confusable with the English text.

Band B1 = pages p01-p06 = Q1-Q42, a contiguous run with no gap. Per-page: p01 Q1-4 (2 cols x 2 q), p02 Q5-10, p03 Q11-17, p04 Q18-25, p05 Q26-34, p06 Q35-42.

BAND EDGES: Q1 is complete and is the first question on p01 (page starts fresh; nothing continues from the cover). Q42 is complete — its four options all sit in the right column of p06 and nothing spills. Verified p07 (first page of the next band): it opens with Q43 ('What are the four human blood types in ABO blood group typing ?') in the left column and Q47 in the right, so B1/B2 meet cleanly at 42/43 with no shared or straddling item.

SHARED CODE BLOCK: none. There is no 'Directions:' header anywhere on p01-p06 and no question depends on an option block printed under a different question. Every one of the 42 items prints its own complete (a)-(d) block. Q3 is the only Match List in the band and its Code table is printed directly under its own Lists.

TWO-COLUMN CHECK: every question's option block was re-read against the stem directly above it IN THE SAME COLUMN. The columns are separated by a printed vertical rule on all six pages, and question numbers in the opposite column intrude into the margin (e.g. '8.'/'9.' beside Q5/Q6 on p02) — those were ignored as neighbours, not as owners of the adjacent options.

COMPUTER SCIENCE: no computer/electronics questions anywhere in Q1-Q42. The nearest are Q30 (Van de Graaff generator — electrostatics) and Q32 (graphene, whose option (d) mentions 'wide band-gap semiconductor' but the question tests an allotrope's properties, not semiconductor physics). The flagged Q81-Q84 run is outside this band.

PAGE DEFECTS: pages are clean scans, fully legible; no torn/blurred/missing regions. One genuine PRINT defect found and preserved: Q16 statement 2 prints 'Indian Institue of Public Administration' (missing 't' in 'Institute') while statement 1 on the line above prints 'Institute' correctly — confirmed at 8x zoom. See that question's flags.

CATALOG GAPS (2): Q9 (Durand Line) and, more generally, named international boundary lines (Radcliffe, McMahon, Durand, 38th Parallel) have no home — 'World and Human Geography' offers only coordinates/rivers/ports/megacities subtopics. Q19 (Special Category Status criteria) sits between Polity federal-finance and Economics public-finance; filed under Polity federal structure.

SUBSTANTIVE NOTES (transcribed as printed, not corrected): Q22 option (c) is (v1+v2)L / 2v1v2, which is dimensionally a TIME, not a speed — a deliberate distractor rather than a misprint, and the option is printed exactly as given. Q37's superscript ranges were re-read at 8x to fix the (n-1)/(n-2) and 0-1/0-2 distinctions.

Decimal points throughout the paper are typeset as a raised middle dot (Indian convention, e.g. '0·1 second', '1·65 m'); these are transcribed as ordinary '.' since it is a typographic convention, not content.
